Bento for macOS 0.2.12
What’s new
- Calmer layouts: calculate available space before moving windows. - Reuse the least recently used window’s slot when the desktop is full, keeping other windows in place where possible. - Stop repeated layout attempts: allow only one correction for an unknown app size, with no automatic rearrangement animation. - Improve Install and Relaunch: restore windows once, avoid waiting for ongoing arrangement retries, and show a retry action if restoration is blocked. - Show these release points directly in the update popup.
